start: Gym tab, Ranking (leaderboard) of the member's gym; another member shows their name and has 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' on

steps.action: Open the leaderboard (by workouts, then by kg)
user_sees: The same top 10 as the leaderboard, names like 'Rahul S.'
Names of sharing members can be tapped; my own row cannot
must_not: A name that can be tapped for a member who does not share
A full surname or phone number shown

user_sees: Their profile: the leaderboard name, their bio (up to 160 letters) and up to 30 workouts of the last 60 days, newest first, each with minutes, kg and up to 8 exercises with the best set
must_not: Body weight, photos, notes or a list of sets

start: Settings, Your gym; switch 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' is off (the default)

steps.action: Turn the switch on, write a short bio
user_sees: The switch stays on; the phone sends the bio and up to 30 recent workout summaries
must_not: Anything sent while the switch was off
Workouts outside the last 60 days kept on the server

steps.action: Open the leaderboard on a gym mate's phone
user_sees: My name can now be tapped there, if I also show my name on the leaderboard
must_not: My profile opens while 'Show my name on my gym's leaderboard' is off

start: A gym mate's profile link that is no longer allowed (they hid their name, stopped sharing, left, or the gym hid them)

steps.action: Tap the name, or open the old profile link
user_sees: A plain message that this member does not share (server answer NOT_SHARED; app words unknown)
must_not: The old bio or workouts shown

steps.action: Save a bio longer than 160 letters, or more than 30 workouts
user_sees: The save is refused (INVALID) with a plain message
must_not: The bio cut without a word

start: The member shares (switch on) and gym mates have opened the profile

steps.action: Turn 'Let my gym mates see my workouts' off
user_sees: The switch is off; the server removes the bio and every shared workout at once
must_not: Any workout left on the server
A gym mate still able to open the profile

user_sees: A fresh profile built from the phone's current workouts
must_not: The old bio or old workouts brought back from the server

start: A member who shares their workouts with gym mates

steps.action: A gym mate opens the profile
user_sees: Only the leaderboard name from the gym's own list, the bio and workout summaries
must_not: Phone number, body weight, photos or notes
A name typed on the phone instead of the gym's record

user_sees: The shared profile and workouts are deleted at once
must_not: The profile still open to old gym mates
Data kept after leaving, against the privacy notice
